timeout.recommendation: Git commands use context with deadline from the HTTP request context

retry.recommendation: Git operations are local filesystem; retries not typically needed

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Local filesystem operations don't benefit from circuit breakers

bulkhead.recommendation: Git operations share the same process; consider limiting concurrent git operations

fallback.recommendation: No fallback possible for git tag operations; failure returns error to user

idempotency.reason: Tag creation is not idempotent - creating same tag twice would fail. Delete is also not idempotent.

blast_radius.impact: Release creation/update/delete would fail; read endpoints (ep-240, ep-241, ep-242) unaffected

findings.detail: LoadAttributes called per release in loop; GetReleaseAttachments supports batch but isn't used that way here

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Database overload with many concurrent list requests

findings.detail: Git tag creation and DB insert are not in a single transaction; if DB insert fails after tag creation, orphan tag remains
findings.recommendation: Consider cleanup of git tag on DB insert failure

findings.detail: Duplicate creation is prevented by IsReleaseExist check, returning 409

non_atomic_operations: Git tag creation + DB insert are separate operations
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Low - only affects the specific release being created

findings.detail: DB attachment deletion and storage file deletion are separate; storage failures are logged but not returned as errors
findings.recommendation: Already handled gracefully - storage failures don't block the operation

non_atomic_operations: DB record deletion + storage file deletion are separate; storage failures logged only
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Low - orphan files in storage if deletion fails
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Storage deletion failures are logged but don't fail the request

graceful_shutdown.detail: Gitea uses modules/graceful for shutdown handling

rate_limiting.detail: No per-endpoint rate limiting on release APIs
rate_limiting.recommendation: Consider rate limiting on write endpoints (create/edit/delete)

dead_letter_queues.detail: No async message processing in release endpoints

single_points_of_failure: Database (single DB connection for all operations)
cascading_failure_paths: Database down → all release endpoints fail
Git repository filesystem unavailable → create/edit/delete fail, reads still work from DB
